categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Gaoce Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of high-hardness brittle material cutting equipment and consumables. Its main product lines include photovoltaic (PV) cutting equipment, PV cutting consumables (diamond wire), silicon wafer cutting and processing services, and other high-hardness brittle material cutting equipment and consumables used in semiconductor, sapphire, magnetic materials, and silicon carbide industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including precision mechanical design and manufacturing, automation detection and control, and precision electrochemical technology. It emphasizes integrated solutions combining cutting equipment, consumables, and cutting processes, with innovations in tungsten wire cold drawing for diamond wire, ultra-fine wire cutting technology, high-speed cutting, automation, and intelligent manufacturing. It also employs proprietary production lines for diamond wire and advanced cutting machines like GC-800XS slicing machines and integrated grinding-polishing equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are manufacturers in the photovoltaic industry, especially silicon wafer producers, as well as semiconductor, sapphire, magnetic material, and silicon carbide material manufacturers. The company serves upstream segments of the PV industry chain, providing equipment and consumables for silicon wafer cutting and processing services. It also targets emerging markets in semiconductor wafer cutting and other high-hardness brittle materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production and R&D centers in Qingdao, Chengdu, Suzhou, Yancheng, and other locations. It has expanded its global footprint with overseas subsidiaries and sales in countries including Laos, India, the United States, France, Vietnam, Turkey, and parts of Europe and Southeast Asia. It actively participates in international exhibitions to promote its products globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao Gaoce Technology operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the photovoltaic and semiconductor supply chains, focusing on manufacturing cutting equipment and consumables and providing silicon wafer cutting processing services. It is positioned as a key technology and equipment supplier to silicon wafer manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment focusing on fine wire cutting technology, automation, and intelligent manufacturing. It pursues a 'deliver one generation, develop one generation, pre-research one generation' innovation strategy, emphasizing integration of equipment, consumables, and processes. Future R&D focuses include ultra-thin wafer cutting, tungsten wire fine wire iteration, BC silicon wafer half-cutting technology, and expansion into semiconductor, sapphire, silicon carbide, and magnetic materials cutting solutions, leveraging AI and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of cutting equipment and consumables to end customers, and through silicon wafer cutting processing services charged via contract manufacturing fees. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment income, and other operating revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qingdao Gaoce Technology is a leading domestic supplier in China’s high-hardness brittle material cutting equipment and consumables market, holding the largest market share in photovoltaic cutting equipment and a significant position in diamond wire production. It competes globally with other major PV equipment and consumable manufacturers, maintaining competitive advantages through technology leadership and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 4.47 billion, a 27.65% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to industry-wide price declines. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 44.2 million, reflecting a 103.03% decrease. Total assets stood at about RMB 7.75 billion, with net assets of RMB 3.68 billion. Despite short-term profit declines, the company has expanded production capacity and maintains strong R&D investment at 5.55% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated 'equipment + consumables + process' technology closed-loop, providing customers with comprehensive system cutting solutions that reduce production costs, improve efficiency, and enhance product quality. Its proprietary technologies in tungsten wire cold drawing and ultra-fine diamond wire cutting, combined with automation and intelligent manufacturing capabilities, differentiate it by enabling high precision, high speed, and low-cost cutting solutions for PV and other high-hardness brittle materials.
